evaluation.airport_terminal: Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC) is in the CITY OF SALT LAKE CITY, 84122. No hotel stands inside the terminal.
evaluation.airport_hotel_row: The airport's own hotel row -- West North Temple, Wright Brothers Drive, Admiral Byrd Road, Amelia Earhart Drive, Jimmy Doolittle Road -- is 84116 / 84122: the slc-airport-west-side corridor, municipality SALT LAKE CITY.
evaluation.airport_marketed_elsewhere: 'Salt Lake City Airport' hotels on 2100 South / Bangerter Highway / 3500 South in West Valley City (84119 / 84120 / 84128) and in Woods Cross / North Salt Lake are placed by their own code and keep their own municipality.
evaluation.one_premises_one_row: A property is one row however many of 'Airport', 'SLC', 'Salt Lake', 'Downtown' and 'Temple Square' its marketing carries; identity is its own street address, phone and brand property code.

municipality_accounting.rule: Every admitted row publishes the municipality its OWN postal code carries (GEO.POSTAL_PARISH); 'Park City' only for 84060 / 84068 / 84098, and those codes publish nothing else. A stated 'Salt Lake City' on a code that does not carry it (Murray, West Valley City, Midvale, Sandy...) is kept as stated_city evidence and never published.
